# TableBook
Tiny web app for small restaurants: log daily covers and sales, see sales per cover.
Run: `python3 app.py` then open http://127.0.0.1:8000. Tests: `python3 -m unittest` or `python3 -m pytest`.
Status: prototype, in-memory storage. Built for my parents' 40-seat restaurant.
